title: ML nominates a plasma protein panel for Alzheimer's dementia in African Americans
summary: Untargeted SomaScan 7k plasma proteomics in African American participants with Alzheimer's dementia (n=183) or cognitively unimpaired (n=145) was analysed with machine learning to select the protein set with the best classification accuracy. The panel reached an AUC of 0.91, and reproducibility was seen in the ANMerge plasma dataset (AUC 0.83) and the AMP-AD Diversity brain dataset (AUC 0.94). Preprint with a modest sample; one reproduction dataset is brain rather than plasma.
ai_technology: Machine-learning selection of plasma proteins from SomaScan 7k data
organization: Mayo Clinic; Mayo Clinic in Florida

evidence.tested: Reproduction of the panel in two independent datasets.
evidence.unknown: Performance in larger independent plasma cohorts and clinical utility; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Machine learning selected the protein set that best separated Alzheimer's dementia from controls.
